11th of Greywood — Wind from the north. Bell stable. No resonance shift.

14th of Greywood — Old Petrs heard something in the upper chamber. I went up. Nothing. The bell looks the same.

17th of Greywood — The bell is cracked. I did not see it happen. I am not going up there again until the guild sends someone.

[The remaining pages are stuck together.]
